policy: Use only sources whose text reuse and machine-learning use can be traced to an official license. Unknown or contract-restricted text is prohibited.

candidates.name: Japanese Wikipedia official pages-articles dump
candidates.usable_scope: Article text with per-article attribution URL, revision metadata, modification notice, and ShareAlike compliance.
candidates.token_estimate: Selected cleaned shard portion: about 26.1M exact Foundation tokens.
candidates.reason: Official Wikimedia distribution, stable encyclopedic Japanese, traceable revision and attribution.

candidates.name: Japanese Wikibooks official pages-articles dump
candidates.usable_scope: Educational article text with per-page attribution URL, revision metadata, modification notice, and ShareAlike compliance.
candidates.token_estimate: Cleaned full dump: about 10.8M exact Foundation tokens.
candidates.reason: Official educational corpus complements encyclopedia prose with explanations and procedures.

candidates.name: Balanced Corpus of Contemporary Written Japanese (BCCWJ)
candidates.license: Contract-based; not an open corpus license
candidates.usable_scope: Online search or paid contract according to NINJAL terms; text-derived product use is restricted.
candidates.reason: Cannot redistribute or incorporate the text into this reusable model without a suitable separate agreement.

candidates.name: Corpus of Spontaneous Japanese (CSJ)
candidates.usable_scope: Use only under an individual NINJAL license agreement.
candidates.token_estimate: Large spoken corpus; exact Foundation tokens not estimated because access was not authorized.
candidates.reason: No project-wide redistribution or model-use authorization is available in the workspace.

candidates.name: UD Japanese GSD
candidates.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 for the treebank; underlying-content notice applies
candidates.usable_scope: Dependency-treebank research subject to repository notices.
candidates.token_estimate: Small, below the multi-million-token scale needed for Base pretraining.
candidates.reason: News/blog genre and small scale do not address the stable general-language corpus bottleneck; may be reconsidered for syntax evaluation.

candidates.name: Common Crawl derived Japanese corpora (mC4/OSCAR/CC-100 class)
candidates.license: Source-page copyright varies; corpus packaging license is not blanket text permission
candidates.usable_scope: Requires source-level rights filtering and attribution not implemented here.
candidates.reason: Page-level licenses cannot be verified reliably; indiscriminate web scraping is prohibited.

candidates.name: megagonlabs/instruction_ja
candidates.usable_scope: 669 manually modified Japanese dialogs under repository terms.
candidates.token_estimate: Small instruction dataset, not a Base-pretraining-scale corpus.
candidates.reason: Instruction/dialogue data must remain outside Stage A and its translation lineage requires a separate later-stage review.
